reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of university degree programs through orders made under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory compliance requirements, and modifications to existing legal frameworks governing higher education.
